description: Atif Gul's personal engineering-standards marketplace. Portable, opinionated craft skills applied identically across all repos.

plugins.name: craftsman
plugins.description: Ship something with Lovable, Replit, Bolt, v0, or Claude Code and it works, but nobody with an engineering background has checked it. Written by a software engineer of 25 years, including at Microsoft and Amazon. Before you let real customers in, craft-audit checks it the way a senior engineer would, across ten areas: security is one of them, alongside the database rules that keep one customer's data separate from another's, and whether the money path is tested and errors get seen before a customer has to report them. It writes plain-language findings to a workspace in your project so a long audit can pause and resume. The companion skill, craft-fix, drives the fixes, but it can never mark its own work fixed; only a fresh audit pass can confirm that. A worked example is included, so you can see exactly what it finds before you run it.
